jobs.occupation: Senior Project Planning and Controls Specialist
jobs.description:
Join the Hitachi Energy GPQSS business unit in Västerås for a dynamic and engaging role in complex projects. As a central member of the project management team, you will collaborate closely with the project group to drive success.
GPQSS, a unit within Hitachi Energy, pioneers FACTS technology, enabling power system owners to enhance capacity and stability. This results in more electrical power reaching consumers with minimal environmental impact, shorter project times, and lower investment costs. Developed in Västerås and sold globally, our technology is at the forefront of innovation.
Our team specializes in power quality systems, excelling in comprehensive planning, managing project timelines, tendering, and execution. We integrate planning with cost management and resource demand to ensure seamless project delivery. In this role you will manage large projects with high complexity and several interfaces globally.
“As member in our team, you’ll navigate diverse stakeholder needs and coordinate project components. Your leadership will ensure we meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results. Make a significant impact on advancing a sustainable energy future with us!” - Karila Santos, Hiring Manager
How you’ll impact
Leverage your expert knowledge of Project Controls to manage the scheduling process for our delivery projects.
Create, maintain, and analyze current and forecasted schedules, including costs, resources, and risks.
Develop solutions to handle delays and ensure project timelines are met.
Follow up on projects, produce reports, and conduct regular analyses (e.g., S-curves, OTD, earned value, and critical path).
Highlight deviations and potential issues to project managers and the project team.
Collaborate closely with project leaders and team members, playing a key role in the further development of Project Controls.

Your background
You bring approximately 7 years of experience in Planning & Scheduling, Project Controls, Earned Value Analysis, and follow-up with S-curves, particularly using Primavera P6. Experience with other planning systems is a plus.
You are self-driven, take personal responsibility, and are both structured and organized.
You thrive in a team environment, motivating and inspiring your colleagues.
You excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously and making effective prioritization decisions.
You possess a strong knowledge of Excel and Office packages.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous.

More About Us​
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing wellbeing, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grows together. ​
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​
Group life insurance and additional insurance. ​
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​
Health care and wellness allowance ​
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​
Psychological support program ​
Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​
Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit yours today. ​
Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Eva Schölin, eva.scholin@hitachienergy.com

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We are now looking for a Recruitment Partner to join our team in Stockholm in early 2027 for a one-year temporary position, covering for a colleague during their absence, with the possibility of transitioning to permanent employment.. In this role, you will manage recruitment across technical, creative, and business roles, working closely with hiring managers and our HR Manager to bring great people into our teams.
The Role
You will take ownership of recruitment from the initial hiring brief through to a well-prepared start for each new colleague, combining proactive sourcing with close collaboration across the business. You will help hiring managers make informed decisions, keep recruitment processes moving, and ensure candidates feel informed and supported throughout. This requires curiosity about our business and the different professions within it, along with the ability to turn changing hiring needs into clear priorities and timely action.
Your key responsibilities include:
Managing end-to-end recruitment processes across technical, creative, and business roles.
Partnering with hiring managers to define hiring needs, role requirements, and candidate profiles, and plan recruitment timelines around team capacity and intended start dates.
Proactively sourcing and approaching talent, including highly specialised roles, building relationships with candidates for current and future opportunities.
Advising hiring managers on interview structure, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.
Coordinating interviews, gathering feedback, and ensuring clear and timely communication throughout each process.
Working closely with the HR Manager to align recruitment priorities with business needs.
Coordinating preparations for new starters with hiring managers, HR, and relevant colleagues to ensure practical arrangements and onboarding plans are in place.
Maintaining accurate and up-to-date recruitment systems, documentation, and reporting.
Identifying and driving improvements to recruitment processes, tools, and ways of working.

What We’re Looking For
Experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment processes.
Experience sourcing and approaching candidates, including for specialist roles.
The ability to build strong relationships with hiring managers and act as a trusted recruitment partner, adapting your communication to different roles, perspectives, and levels of the organisation.
Sound judgment when assessing candidates and supporting hiring decisions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
A structured and proactive approach, with the ability to manage several recruitment processes and shifting priorities.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn about different professions, technologies, and teams to understand what makes someone successful in each role.
Confidence in taking initiative, constructively challenging established ways of working, and bringing people together around improvements.
A thoughtful approach to candidate experience, with clear communication and consistent follow-through.
Professionalism, discretion, and care when handling confidential information.

Nice to Have
Experience recruiting within gaming, iGaming, or tech.
Experience recruiting across technical, creative, and business disciplines.
Experience working in a growing organization with changing hiring needs.
Experience improving recruitment processes and working with applicant tracking systems.
Proficiency in Swedish.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
The opportunity to work with experienced and passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The chance to help build the teams behind games played by a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and opportunities for personal and professional growth.
Wellbeing benefits, including a wellness allowance and regular in-office massages.

Practical Details
Start date: Early 2027, for a one-year temporary position with the possibility of transitioning to permanent employment.
This is a temporary cover position, with the possibility of extension.
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?
Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signaling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
 
 
Could you be the full-time  Traction Electrical Design Engineer in Västerås we’re looking for?
 
Your future role
Get on-board and apply your expertise in a new cutting-edge field. You’ll report to the Head of Converter Electrical Engineering, and work alongside collaborative and driven teammates.
 
As a Traction Electrical Design Engineer, you will drive and support technical investigations and collaborate with many different functions within engineering, manufacturing and suppliers to deliver smart, innovative propulsion products to customers all over the world. In this role you will be responsible for design circuit diagrams and create Routine test documentation, define interfaces, analyze costumer requirements, support routine test activities related to this area. Plan and coordinate the work related to circuit diagram design and routine test documentation. As a converter electrical design engineer, you must have a passion for bringing both people and all the technical details together. In this role you will have the opportunity to be part of all phases in the product life cycle from design to final validation, and field support once our products are delivered to customers.
 
We’ll look to you to:
Design circuit diagrams and create routine test documentation for our traction products. Plan and lead the work of a small project team of engineers both onsite and offsite related to circuit design and routine test documentation.
Drive and support technical investigations and design activities related to the circuit design and routine test scope for products in development and in the field.
Define electrical interfaces.
Collaborate with and support system engineering, manufacturing engineers and test engineers.
Analyze customer requirements
As part of the development team, perform one or more of the following development activities, design circuit diagrams, create test documentation, support routine test activities, support prototype and pre-series in production.
Support product lead with bid support, analyzing requirements from customers or system architects and translate them into requirements related to the circuit diagram design routine test for the converter product.
Support other functions, colleagues with reviews.

 
 
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Degree in Electrical Engineering, Higher Vocational Education specialized in Electric Power or equivalent education
Some experience in relevant field of electrical engineering (Tracion engineering, Circuit diagram design)
Knowledge of E3 (circuit diagram tools) is desirable.
Experience of planning, coordination or leading a smaller team onsite/offsite is an advantage.
English, business fluent, is mandatory for this role and Swedish is an advantage

 
Things you’ll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges and a long-term career, free from boring daily routines
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful and humble colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

 
You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
 
 
 
Important to note
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 70+ countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Software Engineer – Join Us in Building the Future of Dairy Farming at DeLaval
 
Are you a software developer who enjoys solving real-world problems with clean, scalable code? Do you want your work to have a meaningful impact beyond the screen? At DeLaval, we’re looking for a technically driven and collaborative Software Developer to join our cross-functional team developing DeLaval Plus – our digital platform supporting modern dairy farmers around the world.
 
Role and responsibilities
In this role, you’ll work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Scrum Masters, UX Designers, QA Engineers, and other developers to build and maintain the frontend and backend services powering the DeLaval Plus website. You’ll be involved in the entire feature lifecycle – from design and development to testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident handling.
 
You will build and evolve functionality that supports our users in their daily work. You’ll help shape robust, secure, scalable, and observable services using modern, cloud-native technologies. This role is ideal for someone who’s excited to deliver reliable systems at scale, enjoys working with data-intensive applications, and is passionate about making a difference in the lives of real users.
 
What You’ll Be Doing
Design, build, and maintain services for DeLaval Plus
Collaborate with a cross-functional team to deliver high-quality features end to end
Write secure and testable APIs following OWASP and clean code principles
Manage infrastructure and deployments using modern IaC and DevOps tools
Work on data-heavy services that are central to our platform’s performance and reliability
Monitor services in production, respond to incidents, and continuously improve system resilience
Contribute to our culture of learning and knowledge sharing

 
Qualifications
We’re looking for someone with at least 7 years of software development experience. You should also have a solid foundation in computer science, with strong knowledge of frontend and backend development.
 
You also have hands-on experience with most or all of the following:  
Languages & Runtime: JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, npm
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, VPC), CDK, Kubernetes, Terraform
Architecture & Patterns: REST API development, API security (authentication, authorization, OWASP best practices), event-driven architecture
Testing & Quality: Jest (unit testing), Cypress (E2E), JMeter (load testing), SonarQube
DevOps & Observability: Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Grafana, Loki, Sentry, OpsGenie
Best Practices: Clean code, secure coding, code reviews, production monitoring, incident response
Special Focus: Experience working with data-intensive and high-traffic applications
Computer Science Fundamentals: Algorithms, data structures, system design

 
Who You Are
You’re not just a developer – you’re a team player and a problem solver. We believe you’ll thrive here if you: 
Take responsibility for your work and follow through
Have strong technical curiosity and a drive to continuously learn
Are proactive and enjoy taking initiative
Value collaboration and helping others succeed
Have experience handling incidents and working with customer service to improve production systems
Have worked with production-grade systems and understand the importance of qu ality, reliability, and supportability
Are fluent in English (required) and preferably also in Swedish
Are able and willing to work from our Tumba office at least 3 days per week

 
Additional information
This is a full-time position based at DeLaval’s headquarters in Tumba, south of Stockholm. We offer a hybrid workplace model, combining on-site work with flexibility to work remotely. Apply today and help us shape the future of farming. 
 
Contact
Hiring manager: Sara Neander Bjorklund, sara.neanderbjorklundext@delaval.com
Recruiter: Mathias Gunnstedt, mathias.gunnstedt@delaval.com
About DeLaval
Our vision is to make sustainable food production possible. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers, dairy farmers, do more with less by providing world-leading milking equipment and solutions. 
 
Today, DeLaval has approximately 4,900 passionate professionals operating in more than 90 markets around the world. DeLaval is part of the Tetra Laval Group. 
 See more at corporate.delaval.com

jobs.occupation: Engineering Manager - Access Control Development QA
jobs.description:
Axis develops innovative products and solutions for physical access control. Our offering brings together connected products and software, including embedded devices, Windows applications, cloud services and mobile apps. As Engineering Manager for Access Control Development QA, you'll lead the team working across these areas and help ensure quality is built into their development. Here you can learn more about our access control products and solutions.
 

Who is your future team?

The Access Control Development QA team consists of 14 highly skilled testers embedded in development Scrum teams across our access control solutions.
Testing is an integrated part of development. You'll help the team focus on the right things, develop its skills and continue improving how it works.
You'll work closely with the Access Control System Test team. You'll also be part of the New Business QA management team, reporting to Andreas Elbing, Director of New Business QA.
 

What you'll do here as Engineering manager?

You'll lead the team and be responsible for its direction and priorities, as well as the development of its members. You'll work closely with the System Test Manager, development managers and product management to understand upcoming needs and make sure the team is ready to support them.
Your main tasks will be to:
Lead and develop the team, supporting individual growth and the team's development
Set direction and priorities with the team and relevant partners
Make testing an effective part of the agile development process
Drive the development of test automation and improvements to CI/CD pipelines
Make sure test environments and labs support the team's work
Follow up on progress, remove obstacles and help the team reach its goals
Collaborate with other QA teams and managers to share knowledge and improve how we work
Contribute to the New Business QA management team
Handle standard management responsibilities such as salary setting, budgeting and recruitment

 

Who are we looking for/Who are you?

You enjoy leading and developing people, and you're genuinely interested in technology and quality. You give people room to take responsibility while being there to offer support and direction when needed.
You build trust, communicate clearly and work well with different perspectives across an organization. You're also comfortable making decisions and helping things move forward.
We'd love to hear that you have:
An engineering degree or equivalent experience
Experience leading and developing engineers or other technical teams
Relevant experience in software testing and agile development
Strong communication skills in English and Swedish, both spoken and written

Experience with test automation, CI/CD, test environments or products combining hardware and software is a plus. An interest in AI and how it can support testing is also welcome.
 

What Axis have to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. 
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide. 
As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. 
Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. 
To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: 
Axis Career Hub 
Life at Axis 
Engineering at Axis 
Innovation at Axis 
 

Ready to act?

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success.
This is a full-time, permanent position based on-site at our Lund headquarters. Travel is limited.
We welcome all applications.
We go through applications continuously so don't wait - send in your application today!
In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Andreas Elbing, Director of New Business QA, at +46 46 272 1800.

Are you an experienced specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology looking for a role where you can combine advanced clinical work, collaboration with highly skilled colleagues, and excellent opportunities for professional development?
We are currently seeking a hepatologist with at least five years of experience as a specialist physician to join a highly specialized team at one of Sweden’s leading university-affiliated hospitals. This opportunity offers the chance to work with complex liver disease, transplantation medicine, and tertiary-level care in a modern and research-oriented environment.
About the department
The department is one of the largest and most specialized units within gastroenterology and hepatology in the Nordic region. It provides both emergency and elective care and works closely with several highly specialized disciplines.
You will become part of an international team of approximately ten specialist physicians with diverse professional backgrounds and areas of expertise. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to the department's culture.
The unit manages a broad spectrum of hepatology cases, including advanced liver disease and liver transplantation, while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, education, and research.
Your role
As a specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology, you will:
Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with complex liver diseases
Participate in both outpatient and inpatient hepatology care
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams involved in advanced liver treatment and transplantation
Contribute to teaching and supervision of junior colleagues and medical students
Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental development
Take part in on-call duties together with experienced colleagues

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who has:
EU-recognized specialist certification in Gastroenterology and Hepatology
At least five years of experience working as a specialist physician
Experience in hepatology and management of advanced liver diseases
Experience related to liver transplantation
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment

Research experience, academic involvement, or a PhD is considered an advantage.
Why work here?
This opportunity combines highly specialized medicine with an excellent quality of life.
The region offers:
Easy access to coastlines, nature, and outdoor activities
A vibrant cultural scene and excellent public services
International connections and modern infrastructure
A safe and family-friendly environment
Excellent opportunities for long-term professional development

You will work in a progressive healthcare setting where innovation, education, research, and high-quality patient care are closely integrated.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career

Role Summary
The Outlet Manager runs day-to-day operations at Uma's Momo, a fast-casual restaurant and take-away in Gothenburg, as we prepare to open our next location. The role goes beyond running a single outlet: the successful candidate will build structured, practical ways of working that support both our current restaurant and our next location, focused on guest issue resolution, demand-based staffing, delivery-order handling, learning from incidents, quality checks and coaching, guest feedback, and training new staff. We are looking for a calm, methodical problem-solver with a strong focus on the guest experience and the ability to turn feedback and data into improvements on the floor. We have seen strong traction since opening, and being able to start immediately is a big plus.
Key Responsibilities
●     Develop and own a guest issue-resolution procedure that classifies complaints and incidents by severity (for example, an allergen reaction is critical and a wrong order is minor), sets out what staff can resolve on the spot (such as a free remake or refund) and what is escalated to the manager, and ensures every case is logged and reviewed
●     Build and manage staff rotas around expected demand, including lunch and dinner peaks, keeping labour cost on target, adjusting staffing in real time, and sharing staff between locations while the next location gets established
●     Set clear, rule-based handling for delivery and online orders, including missing items, late deliveries and refund claims, so that cases are resolved quickly and consistently
●     Go beyond completing HACCP logs: when a food-safety check fails (for example, a temperature reading), investigate the root cause and put corrective and preventive actions in place so it does not recur
●     Carry out regular service and food-quality spot checks using simple scorecards, and use the results to coach staff
●     Monitor Google and delivery-app reviews, reply to guests, and turn patterns into fixes

jobs.occupation: PhD student in pavement engineering / AI based analysis
jobs.description:
VTI, the Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute, is looking for a PhD student in pavement engineering with an emphasis on AI based automated data back-analysis method for pavement conditions and performance predictions. The position will be based in Linköping or Stockholm, Sweden
About the position
The goal of this doctoral project is to increase our knowledge and create new competencies regarding deterioration and condition development of flexible roads at the network level by utilizing artificial intelligence and large datasets. Collected data from rolling road surface testing methods (non-destructive testing) as well as climate data and registered road construction data will be analysed and used to provide reliable information about the structural condition of the pavement structure. Your assignment will be to develop methods to interpret rolling road surface testing data together with climate and pavement layer data to predict the pavement condition. The aim is to use analysis results to predict the mechanical performance of different layers in the road structure as a function of time. You will work in collaboration with the division’s professor of Road and Railway Engineering. The Swedish Transport Administration is funding the project for four years.
Your work will use information from rolling road surface measurements from Sweden and the Nordic region. Although you will devote yourself mainly to your doctoral education, you will also work to some extent with other research, field and laboratory testing, and the dissemination of research results to various actors and stakeholders.
Your qualifications
You have an MSc or equivalent in engineering or sciences, e.g. within Civil and Environmental Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or other relevant fields including computer or computational sciences.
You have an interest in data analysis and modelling, as well as laboratory and experimental work. Experience in the field of pavement/structural/geotechnical engineering, programming and in computational modelling is beneficial. The job duties require a solid foundation in the relevant theory and methodology, and you must be able to compile, analyse and present material independently.
The work will entail numerous contacts with various organisations within the transport field, cooperative partners and other researchers. You must consequently possess both good organisational and cooperative skills, as well as strong skills in written and spoken English. A good knowledge of Swedish is advantageous, but not a requirement.
We will place major emphasis on your personal characteristics, analytical abilities, and ability to take personal initiative and work independently.
Duration of employment
The position is fixed term, with increments of a maximum of one year at a time and will be reassessed on an ongoing basis each year. The position is predicated upon your acceptance into the postgraduate programme at KTH.
As a PhD student, you will be employed by VTI while simultaneously being enrolled in the doctoral programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering at the Division of Highway and Railway Engineering, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm, Sweden.
About VTI
The Swedish National Road and Transport Research Institute (VTI) is an independent and internationally prominent research institute in the transport sector with some 250 employees and an annual turnover of roughly MSEK 300. Our principal task is to conduct commissioned research and development related to infrastructure, traffic and transport. We are dedicated to the continuous development of knowledge pertaining to the transport sector, and in this way contribute actively to the attainment of the goals of Swedish transport policy.
More information
Additional information about the position is available from Research Director Björn Kalman or Professor Sigurdur Erlingsson, +46 (0)13 204123 as well docent Denis Jelagin, +46 (0)8 790 8698.
Information about how we process your personal data when you apply for a job at VTI can be found here: https://www.vti.se/en/about-vti/personal-data
We decline all offerings of advertising or recruiting assistance in connection with this recruitment.
Ref. nr: 2026/0485-3.1
The application
We welcome your application, which must include a personal letter, CV, transcripts, and any other documents you wish to cite.
The deadline for applications is 10 december

Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Welcome to Mycronic!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
In this role, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering group comprising mechanical, electronics, and mechatronics engineers. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across different functions, including architects, service, project management, product management, production, and management. With the majority of Mycronic’s R&D operations and production facilities located on-site in Kista, you will have the opportunity to work in close proximity to both the products you develop and the people involved in bringing them to life.
Work tasks
You will take part in the entire development chain, from requirements specification to design and implementation, while working with a diverse range of materials and technologies, including welded and machined steel structures, large and small aluminum and plastic components, high-precision parts, and units for highly accurate motion control. You will work with a range of products within the PA Division, including for example Mycronic Jet Printers, MYTower systems and Pick-and-Place machines.
You will, for example:

Work with the design of mechanical components and functions.

Participate in multiple parallel projects, covering new product development, maintenance, improvements to existing solutions, and product redesign.

Participate in defining requirements and requirements reviews.

Perform verification and documentation to ensure that designs meet specified requirements.

Contribute to the development and improvement of existing ways of working and solutions by identifying opportunities for improvement and suggesting new solutions, features and accessories.

We are looking for
This role is ideal for a curious and collaborative Mechanical Design Engineer with a genuine passion for technology and engineering. You enjoy exploring new ideas, challenging existing solutions and finding better ways of working. You are eager to develop your skills, share your knowledge and learn from the experience and perspectives of others. You enjoy working hands-on with mechanical design, turning ideas into practical solutions and contributing to continuous improvements. You are a team player who values open communication, enjoys collaborating across functions and is motivated by solving technical challenges together.
Furthermore, you have:
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanics, mechatronics, or a related field. 
At least some years of professional experience in mechanical engineering, covering the entire development life cycle. 
Good knowledge in CAD, Mycronic uses SolidWorks. 
Strong proficiency in English and good knowledge of Swedish (or a willingness to learn).

Other information

Employment: Permanent, Full-time.

Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is seeking a dedicated Testing Engineer who wants to contribute to the development and verification of technology within active safety, automation, and the transport systems of the future.
You will work in a technical team focused on feature development and verification of active safety systems and automated vehicles. The role includes planning and conducting vehicle testing as well as analyzing and documenting test results.
You will work hands-on with both passenger cars and trucks on advanced test tracks and use specialized testing equipment, including driving robot systems and measuring instruments.
The role involves close collaboration with technical specialists, functional managers, developers, and customers. You are expected to contribute technical understanding, accuracy, and a professional approach throughout the entire testing process.
Main tasks
Plan, prepare, lead, and carry out various types of testing assignments.
Conduct vehicle testing with passenger cars and trucks on special test tracks.
Work with advanced testing equipment, including installed robotic systems and measurement equipment.
Collect, analyze, and document test results.
Report test results and ensure clear technical documentation.
Support functional managers and development teams in the ongoing work of developing and verifying products.
Contribute to the development and improvement of testing methods, test equipment, and work processes.
Maintain ongoing contact with customers and ensure a professional and service-oriented collaboration.
Represent the organization with high technical expertise and a solution-oriented approach.

Qualifications and mandatory competence
We are looking for someone with relevant technical education and experience in vehicle-related testing.
Education
Bachelor's or master's degree in mechatronics, electrical engineering, or a related technical field.
Alternatively, equivalent relevant post-secondary education.

Technical experience
Experience in vehicle-related testing and verification.
Experience with advanced measuring equipment.
Experience with ABD missile systems.
Ability to conduct technical tests, analyze results, and document conclusions.

Language and driver's license
Excellent knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
Swedish category B driving license.
Good driving experience.

Meritorious competence
It is an advantage if you also have:
C, CE, and/or D driving licenses.
Experience in customer-focused technical assignments.
Programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB.
Additional experience with advanced test systems, vehicle measurements, and automated test environments.

Personal qualities
We value that you are:
Analytical and meticulous with a structured approach.
Practical and comfortable working outdoors in test environments.
Independent and responsible in planning and conducting tests.
Communicative and service-oriented in contact with customers and colleagues.
Solution-oriented and interested in new technology in vehicles, safety, and automation.
A team player who enjoys collaborating in cross-functional technical teams.

Location and assignment period
Location: Hällered, outside Sandhult, Sweden
Start date: November 30, 2026
End date: November 29, 2027
The role is mainly related to practical work in vehicle and test environments. Presence on test tracks is required to carry out the testing activities.
Application
Are you a testing engineer with experience in vehicle testing, advanced measuring equipment, and automated test systems? Welcome to submit your application.
Apply here: https://www.hykmann.com/careers
Attach an updated CV clearly describing your education, experience in vehicle testing, ABD robotic systems, measuring equipment, and relevant programming skills. Also specify your availability and driver's license eligibility.
